notes.title: Update 1.1.4 - Rebalanced autobattler fights, including tournaments, bug fixes.
notes.notes:
Improved: Re-balance tournament and regular auto-battler fights based on difficulty.
 Improved: Better handling of two honeys and two wine bottles when filling up.
 Fix: gladiators were assigned to beds not bought yet. ( sleeping position will not change for already saved gladiators )
 Fix: wrong bed positions enabled on buy.
 Fix: Another few errors reported by diagnostics

notes.title: Update 1.1.3 - Improved autobattler end screen, bug fixes
notes.notes:
Improved: End of auto-battler fight screen
 Fix: Issues with notification, which could cause notification fail.

notes.notes:
fixed possible issues in tournament auto resolution
few other bugs which would not be visible to player fixed

notes.title: Update 1.1.1 - Player skill stamina was not correctly assigned, many more fixes
notes.notes:
Fix:  Player skill “Marathon Man“ Stamina was not correctly assigned
 Fix: Creating new gladiator could cause exception. looping thru the gladiator looks had incorrect logic adding index before take.
 Fix: Assigning skills could cause exception. parent image for stars was included in loop.
 Fix: Input events assignment corrected.
 Fix: Other 10+ possible null exception reported thru cloud diagnostics

notes.title: Update 1.1 - New shoes/sandals ,improvements ,fixes
notes.notes:
New: Many new shoes/sandals in shop
 Improved: Improved backpack behavior, disable colliders when on the back, disabled forces when on the ground
 Improved: If any object fall thru map it will appear in ludus sand
 Improved: On first start game set quality settings based on player VRAM
 Fix: When player had no weapon in the hand and picked item from ground, then drop it, he could see previously equipped weapon in hand.
 Fix: Disabled HDR and Raytracing, some user reported crashes, I have no way to test this features so better turn them off, in case those are problematic.


I want to thank everyone who reports me any issues, either thru in-game bug report, steam discussion or discord.

notes.title: Release 1.02 - bug fixes
notes.notes:
Fix: Finishing “Milk cow” objective did not trigger complete objective.

notes.title: Release 1.01 - bug fixes
notes.notes:

notes.title: Full release 1.0
notes.notes:
It is time to push it to full release.
